Chinese Cloisonne Desk Stand & Chopsticks Lot
Cloisonne Enamel & Camel Bone Desk & Dining Collectibles
Vintage, Beijing 1991
This vintage Chinese decorative lot includes a brass and cloisonne enamel double pen stand with a center lidded inkwell box, paired with a boxed set of four pairs of camel bone chopsticks with matching blue floral cloisonne handles. Purchased in Beijing in 1991, both items showcase traditional wirework with vibrant floral and scroll motifs on a cobalt ground.

Cloisonne Double Pen Stand: Features two swivel pen sockets and a central lidded compartment with turquoise enameled interior; measures approximately 7.25 inches wide.
Boxed Chopstick Set: Four pairs (8 total) of camel bone chopsticks with cloisonne handles in a patterned brocade fabric case with bone toggles and internal provenance note.
Condition:
Cloisonne enamel remains vibrant and intact with minimal wear. Metal borders show light patina. Brocade storage box has minor handling wear with intact clasps.

Raw Mineral & Rock Specimen Lot
Natural Geological Collection
5 Pieces
This assorted collection of five unpolished geological rock and mineral specimens features diverse textures, crystal formations, and mineral compositions. Ranging from crystalline aggregates to metamorphic and mineralized ore samples, this lot is well suited for educational study, earth science reference, or natural decorative display.
Items Included:
Large matrix plate featuring microcrystalline druzy pockets and earthy mineral tones
Coarse-grained crystalline rock specimen with quartz and feldspar matrix
Orange blocky cleavage specimen exhibiting distinct crystal planes
Elongated foliated metamorphic stone with visible mineral layering
Dense mineral ore rock with reddish-brown oxidation and dark metallic tones
Condition:
All five specimens are in natural, rough raw condition as collected. Surfaces exhibit natural fractures, irregular cleavage edges, natural sediment, and mineral veining. Free of artificial polishing or tumbling.
